test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Many people fought to __put an end to__ slavery during the civil war.
solution:
```html

The correct answer is: **abolish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"abolish"** means to formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution. (समाप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The government decided to abolish the outdated laws.
 
 
 
• **"Abolish"** is used to describe the act of ending slavery or any other system that is considered unjust or outdated. (समाप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Many activists fought to abolish slavery during the civil war.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **abolish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Absorb** (अवशोषित करना): To take in or soak up (energy or a liquid or other substance) by chemical or physical action.
 
 
• **Example:** The sponge can absorb a lot of water.
 
 
 
• **Abide** (पालन करना): To accept or act in accordance with (a rule, decision, or recommendation).
 
 
• **Example:** We must abide by the rules of the game.
 
 
 
• **Abduct** (अपहरण करना): To take (someone) away illegally by force or deception; kidnap.
 
 
• **Example:** The child was abducted by a stranger.
 
 

Question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**
Many people fought to put an end to slavery during the civil war.

The correct answer is: **abolish**.

```
201:Tc03,

The correct answer is: Option 1**.
